source_title: 와뉴비 다들 왜 사제 안키우는 지 알거같다
subtitle: 수도원 주특입 8바퀴 — 화이트메인 템 쟁탈전과 착한 보기님

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
힐모자요? 주문력·정신력 붙었으니
고술인 저도 주특 맞죠! ㅎㅎ
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder (OTS) diagonal action shot recreating the Scarlet Monastery Cathedral boss room right after defeating High Inquisitor Whitemane. Foreground-left: seen over the slumped lavender-haired shoulder of the Night Elf Priest chibi girl (pointed elf ears, golden crescent circlet, white-and-gold priestess robe, her golden crescent staff leaned aside so both hands reach out weakly in dismay). Looking diagonally across a small soft organic floating patch of crimson Scarlet Cathedral carpet (NO straight horizon or wall lines!) where a tiny comical collapsed chibi boss silhouette of white-haired red-robed High Inquisitor Whitemane lies with dizzy spiral eyes beside an open wooden loot chest: on the lower-right, the fair peach-ivory-skinned Troll Shaman chibi girl (sky-blue plush troll hood with bright red spiky mohawk, floppy pierced ears, mint-teal bob hair, patterned tribal scarf, crackling blue lightning sparks) leaps jubilantly balancing an ornate crimson-and-gold Scarlet cloth bishop hat right atop her troll hood while flashing a shameless winking blep tongue-out grin and V-sign; in the tiny lower-center background, a generic chibi hooded mage extra scurries off hugging a gleaming ruby amulet. Keep all characters, fallen boss, and organic carpet patch strictly inside the lower two-thirds, fading seamlessly into 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white headroom across the entire top 38% (both top-left and top-right corners completely pure white for speech bubble and item tooltip). Zero text, zero letters, zero UI.

equip_effects: 착용 효과: 마법 주문 및 효과로 입히는 피해와 치유량이 최대 18만큼 증가합니다.

cuts.dialogue:

왜 죄다 천을 굴려대냐고!!

On a small soft organic floating patch of Scarlet Monastery cobblestone tiles (NO straight horizon or divider lines!), on the far-left sits the exhausted Night Elf Priest chibi girl (lavender-silver hair, pointed elf ears, golden crescent circlet, heavy dark under-eye circles, white-and-gold priestess robe, crescent staff leaned aside) slumped hugging her knees with twitching half-lidded furious eyes, puffed exasperated cheeks, and a tiny plain wand drooping weakly in one hand. 어우 힐무기인 줄 몰랐네요 ㅈㅅ!
이미 착용해서 못 드림 수고요~!

On the lower-right, the fair peach-ivory-skinned Orc Warrior chibi girl (vibrant green plush orc onesie hood with curved cream horns and tiny fangs, black high ponytail, crimson eyes, spiky red pauldrons over silver plate armor, her chunky silver battle axe strapped cleanly across her back — Clean Hand Rule!) sprints frantically rightward in a guilty tiptoe dash kicking up comic dust puffs and swirling cyan instance-exit sparkles, gripping a newly equipped gleaming golden one-handed healer mace (radiating golden soulbound sparkles!) in one hand while glancing back over her shoulder with a sweaty sheepish apologetic grin. Lunging horizontally from the lower-left in mid-stumble is the Night Elf Priest chibi girl (lavender hair flying wildly backward, golden crescent circlet, white-and-gold robe, her crescent staff dropped behind her) tripping forward with jaw dropped wide open and watery panicked eyes reaching both desperate hands after the fleeing Warrior. Keep all figures and dust puffs strictly inside the lower two-thirds with 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white headroom across the entire top 38% (both top-left and top-right corners completely pure white for item tooltip and speech bubble). cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
원래 주문력 붙어서 보기 비스긴 한데...
힐러님 너무 간절해 보이시네요.
전 패스할게요. 드세요.
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle heroic comedic shot looking slightly upward across a soft organic floating patch of Scarlet Cathedral stone floor (NO straight horizon or wall lines!). Standing tall and cool on the lower-right is the Undead Protection Paladin tank chibi girl (round white cartoon skull hood with dark eye sockets, chin-length silver-white bob hair with icy blue inner tips, crisp white-and-gold paladin cloak with cream neck bow) wearing a sturdy shiny golden paladin crest shield strapped cleanly on her left forearm (her own one-handed weapon neatly sheathed at her waist — Tank Shield & Clean Hand Rules!), calmly extending the radiant glowing golden one-handed healer mace forward in her right gloved hand with soft warm golden light rays behind her and a stoic half-lidded gentle smile. Crouched kneeling low on the lower-left is the Night Elf Priest chibi girl (crescent staff leaned aside) leaning eagerly upward with tightly clasped trembling hands, rosy cheeks, and gigantic shimmering starry tearful puppy-dog lilac eyes gazing in awe at the mace. Keep all figures and golden rays strictly inside the lower two-thirds with 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white headroom across the entire top 38%. Zero text, zero letters, zero UI.
